title.narrative: "One-stop shop” for the monitoring and assessment of the implementation of standard-setting instruments

description.narrative: At the 217th session of the Executive Board, the CR Committee noted that an IT platform was being developed within CLT to centralize the receipt of reports from Member States on the implementation of standard-setting instruments in the field of culture, with a view to preparing the first world report on cultural policies. As soon as the platform is fully operational within CLT, it can then be rolled out to the other programme sectors, with each sector adapting it where necessary to suit the specific needs of the consultations on the implementation of standard-setting instruments within their areas of expertise. Following this roll-out, a dedicated page will be set up in the section of the Legal Affairs website devoted to the first aspect of the terms of reference of the CR Committee (monitoring of the implementation of UNESCO’s standard-setting instruments), which would direct Member States to a central source of information related to the various consultations under way and provide easy access to each of the relevant platforms, thus constituting a “one-stop shop” for the monitoring of the implementation of standard-setting instruments. Thanks to a generous voluntary contribution from the Government of Switzerland, allocated in December 2023 to LA (96,000 Swiss francs), the CR Committee Secretariat will, at the start of the current budget period 2024-2025, during which four consultations will be initiated, launch a web page that will bring together the necessary information relating to these various consultations, and which will benefit as far as possible from the technical functionalities that will be developed in 2025 when the CLT IT platform is set up and extended to the other programme sectors.
